plan.note: R18 D2 denominator: ten real, pinned npm plugins with different shapes (theme / tool provider / workspace / scheduler / notify / MCP / remote / git / archive / status) plus three labelled synthetic failure shapes. No expectation is predicted for the real ones: their verdict is the measurement. All are permissively licensed (MIT / Apache-2.0), installed into a throwaway DSH_HOME and deleted afterwards; nothing is vendored (ADR-0004). Four fixture shapes (apply-time failure, import-time failure, no observable row, slower-than-the-settle-budget) are included so this batch also demonstrates that the probe tells those apart; they are marked real:false and never count toward the denominator.
